sdks.title: LayerFS SDK
sdks.description: Branches, files, Sandboxes and Workspaces from a Node script or the layerfs command.

calls.name: client.open
calls.description: Connects to an existing project; a missing project is refused right away.

calls.name: client.init
calls.description: Copies a folder into a new project as main at L0, then connects.

calls.name: client.close
calls.description: Releases the client; Workspaces stay mounted.

calls.name: project.list_branches
calls.description: Pages through the project's Branches, main first.

calls.name: project.list_sandboxes
calls.description: Pages through the running Sandboxes; starts nothing.

calls.name: branch.fork
calls.description: New Branch from main, a Branch, a Commit or a Layer; copies nothing.

calls.name: branch.list_commits
calls.description: A Branch's Commits, newest first.

calls.name: branch.diff_commits
calls.signature: diff_commits(from, to, pageSize = 50, pagePos = 0, { cursor, hunks } = {})
calls.description: Paths changed between two Commits, with their hunks.

calls.name: branch.diff_branches
calls.signature: diff_branches(from, to, pageSize = 50, pagePos = 0, { cursor, hunks } = {})
calls.description: Paths changed between two Branch heads, with their hunks.

calls.name: branch.merge
calls.description: Merges a and b into a new Branch; a and b stay unchanged.

calls.name: branch.publish
calls.description: Makes the Branch head, or a given Commit, main's next Layer.

calls.name: fs.read
calls.description: A line range of a text file, up to 2000 lines or 48 KiB.

calls.name: fs.list
calls.description: Pages through one folder's entries.

calls.name: fs.stat
calls.description: Type, inode and size of a path.

calls.name: fs.grep
calls.description: Lines containing the text, as plain text rather than a regex.

calls.name: fs.glob
calls.description: Paths matching a glob.

calls.name: fs.diff_files
calls.description: Hunks between two files, at any refs.

calls.name: fs.blame
calls.description: The Commit that last changed each line.

calls.name: fs.write
calls.description: Creates or replaces a file on a Branch (not main), as one Commit.

calls.name: fs.edit
calls.description: Replaces exactly one match of oldText, as one Commit.

calls.name: fs.apply
calls.description: Several write, edit, mkdir, rm, cp and mv changes as one Commit.

calls.name: fs.mkdir
calls.description: Creates a folder and any missing parents.

calls.name: fs.rm
calls.description: Removes a file or a folder tree.

calls.name: fs.cp
calls.description: Copies a file or tree.

calls.name: fs.mv
calls.description: Moves or renames a file or tree, keeping its history.

calls.name: workspace.mount
calls.description: Mounts a writable Workspace on a Branch in a running Sandbox.

calls.name: workspace.exec
calls.description: Runs bash -c at the Workspace root; it has no timeout of its own.

calls.name: workspace.commit
calls.description: Saves all changes as one Commit; merges if the Branch has moved.

calls.name: workspace.unmount
calls.description: Removes the Workspace; refused while it has uncommitted changes.

calls.name: sandbox.create
calls.description: Starts the project's next Sandbox.

calls.name: sandbox.list_workspaces
calls.description: The Workspaces mounted in one Sandbox.

calls.name: sandbox.close
calls.description: Stops and deletes the Sandbox; refused while Workspaces are mounted.
